M-MSBUILD.Purpose: Single MSBuild mechanism of the repository: shared compilation configuration, framework wiring for consumers, RimWorld mod deployment, and package build — the entire Source/MSBuild layer.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Directory.Build.props/targets and the MSBuild/ props chain (Paths, PackageMetadata, Compiler, Environment).
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Framework wiring: ProjectReference to FlexVerse, source generator as Analyzer, PropertyWeaver, Fody. DeployToModFolder into Mods/{mod}/Assemblies and the FlexVerse package build. nuget.config, global.json, FlexVerse.slnx. Authored mod content (About.xml, Languages/) — product identity owned by P-FLEXVERSE and P-FLEXTOOLS. Running builds — done by S-VERIFICATION stages and developers via dotnet CLI.

Requirements.REQ-001: A Debug build of the test mod carries [Conditional("DEBUG")] markers into the game container (M-TEST-GAME-SOURCE runs depend on it).
Requirements.REQ-002: DeployToModFolder copies {AssemblyName}.dll (+pdb) into $(ModsDir)$(ModName)/Assemblies after Build when ModName is set.
Requirements.REQ-003: The weaver path is injected locally (InjectLocalWeaverPath) so consumer builds need no published Fody package.

Inputs.IN-001: csproj files of Source/ projects; ModName/ModsDir properties.

Outputs.OUT-001: compiled assemblies deployed to Mods/{mod}/Assemblies and the FlexVerse package.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Writes build outputs into Mods/ and package directories on every Build.

M-MSBUILD.Codemap: * `Directory.Build.props` -> `FlexVerse.Paths.props` + `FlexVerse.PackageMetadata.props` + `FlexVerse.Compiler.props` * `Directory.Build.targets` -> `FlexVerse.Environment.targets` + `FlexVerse.RimWorld.targets` + `FlexVerse.Debug.targets` * `FlexVerse.Debug.targets` -> `ProjectReference(FlexVerse)` + `ProjectReference(FlexVerse.SourceGenerators) : Analyzer` + `ProjectReference(FlexVerse.PropertyWeaver.Fody)` + `PackageReference(Fody)` => consumer wiring * `InjectLocalWeaverPath` + `EnsureNuGetLocalDir` => local weaver resolution * `FlexVerse.RimWorld.targets` -> `DeployToModFolder` -> `$(ModsDir)$(ModName)/Assemblies/{AssemblyName}.dll + .pdb` * `FlexVerse.Package/build/FlexVerse.targets` => package artifacts * `nuget.config` + `global.json` + `FlexVerse.slnx` : repo build config
